title: Overview
text:
appstore-spec documents the hax appstore specification: schema that defines external media providers, upload targets, reusable stax templates, and autoloaded elements for editor. an payload is typically returned by a backend endpoint (for example generateappstore) or loaded from static json file. reads these keys at top level via haxstore._loadappstoredata in webcomponents elements/hax-body/lib/hax-store.js. wrapped { "data": ... } ignored.
root structure
an usually looks like:


{
  "status": 200,
 "apps": [],
 "stax": "autoloader": {}
}



top-level keys


status â numeric status code (typically 200).
apps array of app provider definitions (hax-app data).
stax content stacks (hax-stax data).
autoloader object custom element imports to preload.



example.json repository has representative derived current integrations, examples/ directory more, including invalid/ subfolder mistakes validator catches.
machine-readable validation
schema/appstore.schema.json draft 2020-12 with behavior notes this documentation embedded as descriptions. scripts/validate.js adds checks cannot express, including:

credentials committed data / headers
search ignores
select options all share one value
gizmo.type written literal instead path
_url_source without gizmo.id
duplicate titles

from npm, installing anything:


npx -p @haxtheweb/appstore-spec appstore-validate path/to/appstore.json


from clone repository:


npm install
node example.json examples/*.json
node --json path/to/appstore.json
npm test

title: Apps & Connections
text:
each item in apps is a provider definition with details block (display information) and connection (how hax talks to the provider). 
details fields


title â display label.
icon icon used ui.
color accent color for card.
author owner / source.
description short description shown ui.
status state (commonly available).
tags searchable categorization terms.
tos optional terms policy links.




connection fields


protocol http or https.
url host base path, without protocol.
headers request headers.
data default query values sent every operation.
auto boolean, true: run browse as soon app activated.
operations (required) optionally add. does not read any other operation names.



when haxcms platform setting disables onlinemedia, only an add are loaded.


{
  "details": {
 "title": "youtube",
 "icon": "mdi-social:youtube",
 "color": "red",
 "author": "google, youtube llc",
 "description": "the most popular online video sharing remix site.",
 "status": "available",
 "tags": ["video"]
 },
 "connection": "protocol": "https",
 "url": "www.googleapis.com/youtube/v3",
 "data": "key": "{{youtube_api_key}}"
 "operations": {}
 }
}


build urls way does: protocol + "://" url "/" endpoint. so connection.url has no protocol, operations endpoint leading slash.
never commit real credentials. use {{name}} placeholder backend fills in, broker through your (haxcms this). site_token data x-haxcms-site-token header, session jwt added authorization: bearer header automatically.

title: Operations
text:
operations define how hax talks to a provider. each apps connection.operations object supports required browse operation and an optional add operation. 
common fields


method â http method (get, post, etc).
endpoint path appended connection.url after / (no leading slash).
data request query values, merged over connection.data.
resultmap mappings from the provider response into preview/gizmo data.




browse-only fields


search search inputs. only first key is used: merlin's "search <app title>" command sends user's text as that parameter. further keys, legacy format items slot component hints, are not rendered by current hax, so put fixed filters in data.
pagination { style: "page" | "offset" "link", props: {...} }. stored but used any ui today.



browse operation
browse standard for searching selecting media.


{
  "browse": {
 "method": "get",
 "endpoint": "search",
 "pagination": "style": "page",
 "props": "previous": "prevpagetoken",
 "next": "nextpagetoken",
 "total_items": "pageinfo.totalresults"
 }
 },
 "search": "q": "title": "type": "string"
 "data": "part": "snippet",
 "video",
 "maxresults": "20"
 "resultmap": "defaultgizmotype": "items": "items",
 "preview": "snippet.title",
 "details": "snippet.description",
 "image": "snippet.thumbnails.default.url",
 "id": "id.videoid"
 "gizmo": "description": "id.videoid",
 "_url_source": "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=<%= id %>",
 "caption": "citation": "snippet.channeltitle"
 }
}


add operation
add upload/create flows, example local file upload haxcms integrations.


{
 "add": "post",
 "system/savefile",
 "acceptsgizmotypes": ["image", "video", "audio", "pdf", "svg", "document", "csv"],
 "item": "data.file",
 "image",
 "source": "url",
 "uuid"
 }
}


an needs acceptsgizmotypes, or app never offered target. * means "files can't classify," "everything."

title: resultMap & Special Values
text:
resultmap maps upstream api response data into hax item previews and final gizmo values. 
resultmap fields


items â dot path to the array of result records. if it doesnt resolve, whole is used as array.
preview fields shown in cards: title, details (html stripped) id are required; image optional, with resultmap.image a fixed fallback.
gizmo target value mappings. these become inserted element's properties via guessgizmo.
defaultgizmotype type for every (image, video, audio, pdf, document, content, wikipedia, ...).
gizmo.type / gizmo.mimetype paths whose resolved picks per (e.g. "type": "data.0.media_type"). writing "video" looks up result.video instead using literal.
_url_source url template; first <%= %> replaced by mapped gizmo.id, becomes source url.



any preview or can use split rule take one piece string:


{
  "property": "uri",
 "op": "split",
 "delimiter": "/",
 "position": 2
}


see examples/split-id.json repository full working example.
add (a uploaded record, e.g. data.file) items.
special request values

recognized special values


site_token sitetoken sent x-haxcms-site-token header, never query string.
__haxappenduploadendpoint__: true prepends haxstore.connectionrewrites.appenduploadendpoint (used haxcms local files).
array values repeat parameter; null sends bare key.
a session jwt, when present, authorization: bearer <jwt> unless you set authorization yourself. older __haxjwt__ placeholder no longer read.

title: Stax & Autoloader
text:
stax is an array of named content stacks (hax elements) users can insert as reusable patterns.


{
  "details": {
 "title": "two column article",
 "author": "haxtheweb core team",
 "description": "content with media to right",
 "status": "available",
 "tags": ["media"]
 },
 "stax": [
 "tag": "grid-plate",
 "properties": "layout": "2-1"
 "content": "<p slot=\"col-1\">example text</p><media-image slot=\"col-2\" source=\"https://example.org/image.jpg\"></media-image>"
 }
 ]
}


autoloader
autoloader declares custom elements that should be available hax. two formats are supported:

an object map: tagname -> importpath, or { "import": path, "haxproperties": {...} } ship hax definition over the wire.
an tag names, each imported from @haxtheweb/<tag>/<tag>.js. this what haxcms php and node.js backends emit.

haxcms filters autoloader by settings/enabledblocks.json when file exists.


{
 "autoloader": "media-image": "@haxtheweb/media-image/media-image.js",
 "video-player": "@haxtheweb/video-player/video-player.js",
 "grid-plate": "@haxtheweb/grid-plate/grid-plate.js"
 }
}


integration notes

backends serve appstore payloads static json dynamic endpoint generation.
in haxcms, provider search brokered through backend endpoints so api keys not exposed browser.
for local integrations, __haxappenduploadendpoint__ site_token recognized special values.

rules for tools agents writing payloads

keep at top level (status, apps, stax, autoloader). must start x-.
build urls way does: protocol + "://" url "/" endpoint. connection.url has no protocol, leading slash.
never commit real credentials. use a {{name}} placeholder fills in, broker request your backend.
put text query first in browse.search. only key used.
resultmap values dot paths into result, including gizmo.type gizmo.mimetype. defaultgizmotype fixed type. preview.title, preview.details preview.id required.
add operations need acceptsgizmotypes, app never offered upload target.
validate scripts/validate.js before shipping payload.
